title: Great Concept, Horribly Executed -- Expect Your Microwave To Get Very Wet
text:
Great Concept, Horribly Executed -- Expect Your Microwave To Get Very Wet. This absolutely needs to be taller. If you put in the recommended amount of water, the water will boil over into the microwave.

Yes, I guess you could place the pasta cooker on a thick towel inside the microwave, but then the towel will get soaked, and we shouldn't have to be required to do this.

This pasta cooker is one of those great ideas that is really poorly executed. What a terrible design. Also, it is extremely difficult to see the second line, aka the water fill line. The pasta fill line is easy to see...so I cannot understand why they made the water line almost impossible to see when you are adding the water.

I absolutely do not recommend this microwave pasta cooker.

Yes, perhaps one could put in less pasta and thus much less than the recommended amount of water, but then that would give you a much smaller serving when the serving is already small even if you put the pasta up to the pasta fill line.
